normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… Tranquillity on 30A Unit #210. Experience true beachfront living where relaxation comes naturally and every day begins with breathtaking Gulf views. Wake up to the sound of waves, step onto your private beach access or spend the afternoon unwinding at the pool and patio. Complimentary seasonal beach setup (March–October) makes your stay effortless, with two chairs, a table and an umbrella waiting for you each day on the sand. This recently remodeled and updated spacious three-suite retreat offers comfort, style and everything you need for the perfect 30A getaway. Enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, generous living spaces and a modern electric living room fireplace for your comfort. Four beach bikes available for exploring the area, cruise to Alys Beach or Rosemary Beach, browse local boutiques, dine at coastal favorites or simply soak in the laid-back 30A vibe.*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Stunning Gulf-Front Location: Panoramic, unobstructed gulf views from this gated Seacrest West condo community with access to a private, uncrowded beach where you can enjoy the soothing sound of the surf as your daily backdrop.Easy Beach & Pool Access: Walk just steps to the beach or unwind at the sparkling, seasonally heated pool. Patio seating and complimentary grills make outdoor lounging and meals effortless.Spacious Comfort with Three Private Suites: Three beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, perfect for families or groups seeking both togetherness and privacy. Each includes a new flat screen smart TV for your streaming and entertainment preferences.Premium Amenities for Relaxation & Adventure: Elevator access, four beach bikes for exploring scenic 30A, a fully equipped kitchen and poolside grilling stations for laid-back evenings at home.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Free bikes, easy beach access, and a pool right outside! It was perfect for our family." – Krystle D.⭐"Wonderful location, GORGEOUS views, and a well-stocked home! We absolutely loved it!" – Amy M.⭐"The condo was even better in person than in the photos. It was extremely clean and located on a beautiful stretch of beach that was less crowded but still close to restaurants!" – Stephen C.*** LIVING AREA ***Kick back in the newly refreshed living area, where comfort meets coastal elegance. The oversized sectional sofa, swivel armchairs and sleek electric fireplace make this the perfect spot to relax after a day in the sun. Expansive windows offer stunning Gulf views and open onto a spacious balcony ideal for sunset cocktails or coffee with a breeze.Sectional sofa and swivel armchairs for relaxed loungingElectric fireplace and flat-screen TV for cozy eveningsFloor-to-ceiling windows showcasing breathtaking ocean viewsBalcony with high-top table, perfect for dining or stargazing*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Channel your inner chef in a fully stocked kitchen featuring new stainless steel appliances, new cabinets and countertops and a separate wine cooler. Whether it’s breakfast at the bar or dinner at the dining table, there’s plenty of space to gather and enjoy time together.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesBuilt-in wine and beverage refrigeratorDining table for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 4*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Nestled in an exclusive gated community, Tranquillity on 30A offers everything you need for a relaxing escape. Cool off in the community pool, grill up a feast poolside or take the short walk to the deeded beach access where uncrowded pristine sands await.Relax by the community pool, complete with comfortable lounge chairs and convenient restroomsEnjoy outdoor dining at dedicated grilling stations, perfect for alfresco mealsExclusive private access to a pristine, deeded beach just a 2-minute walk away*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***After a sun-soaked day by the beach or pool, retreat to one of three beautifully appointed suites, each designed to provide the perfect balance of privacy, comfort and style. With plush bedding, modern amenities and spa-like bathrooms, every guest will feel right at home.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access and a luxurious en-suite bathroom featuring dual vanities, a walk-in shower and an oversized soaking tubTwin Guest Suite: Two twin beds, flat-screen TV and dedicated access to a guest bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in showerKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and an en-suite bathroom with a single vanity, shower/tub combo and a full-size washer & dryer*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the sought-after Seacrest West area, this condo puts you in the heart of 30A’s most vibrant spots. Stroll or bike to nearby Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and local treasures like The Big Chill for live music and dining. From tranquil mornings on a quiet beach to exciting nights out, everything you need is close by.Beach Access: Just steps away, feel the sand between your toes and the calming ocean breeze.The Big Chill (Walk, bike or make a 3-minute drive): Head to this entertainment and dining hotspot, perfect for enjoying live music, tasty eats and a fun, laid-back vibe.Alys Beach (Walk, bike or make a 2-minute drive): Stroll to this serene, upscale beach community known for its stunning white architecture and peaceful atmosphere.Rosemary Beach (Walk, bike or make a 4-minute drive): A short drive to this lively and charming town filled with boutique shops, cozy cafes and a vibrant coastal vibe.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210102
